theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → LipschitzWith L f → Measurable G → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → G x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → ∀ g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖G x‖ₑ * g x ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))
